name: Bi metal, 298 K single-crystal refinement
citation: Z. Wei, C. Dubceac, M. A. Petrukhina and E. V. Dikarev. From a volatile molecular precursor to twin-free single crystals of bismuth. Chemical Communications 55 (2019), 5717–5719.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Single-crystal X-ray diffraction, Bruker D8 Venture PHOTON 100 CMOS, Mo K-alpha; SHELXL-2018/3 refinement, as recorded in the original CIF. Publisher primary abstract verifies twin-free elemental bismuth single-crystal data.

synthesis_conditions.description: Gas-phase growth from dibismuth(II) tetra(trifluoroacetate), verified publisher abstract. Growth temperature/pressure not used as diffraction conditions.

notes: One independent Bi site, multiplicity6, weight1. The A7 structure has three shorter intrabilayer and three longer interbilayer Bi neighbors. The selected CN6 envelope explicitly preserves both 3-fold distance groups; it must not be described as six equal covalent bonds.
The source CIF explicitly reports both 3.0723(4) and3.5294(4) A bond groups. A3.8A cutoff includes these and excludes the next Bi at4.5481A.
This is elemental rhombohedral Bi-I at298K, not a bismuth oxide or a high-pressure allotrope.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Original CIF explicitly records _cell_measurement_temperature and _diffrn_ambient_temperature 298(2) K. No numerical diffraction pressure is recorded; publisher describes ambient conditions.
